note: Original lyrics written for Ragaz (not taken from any song), on what songs now are about: a city at night, missing someone, home, a party, a drive, growing up. Four lines each: the first two are the sthayi, the last two the antara.

songs.title: Last Metro
songs.theme: a city at night, an ex's number still remembered
songs.words:
आख़िरी मेट्रो में बैठा हूँ
शहर की बत्ती गिनता हूँ
तेरा नंबर अब भी याद है
फ़ोन उठाके रख देता हूँ

songs.title: Wet Roads
songs.theme: monsoon, waiting for someone who doesn't come
songs.words:
भीगी सड़कें ख़ाली चाय
खिड़की पे तेरा नाम लिखा
बादल आए तुम ना आए
फिर भी मैंने छाता रखा

songs.title: Mom Calls
songs.theme: living away from home, the evening phone call
songs.words:
माँ पूछे खाना खाया क्या
मैं कहता हूँ हाँ खा लिया
दो रोटी और थोड़ा झूठ
बस इतने में दिन जी लिया

songs.title: Rooftop
songs.words:
छत पे आजा गाना बजा
आज की रात कोई ग़म नहीं
पैरों में ताल हाथों में हाथ
कल की बातें कल ही सही

songs.title: Headlights
songs.theme: driving at night to let go
songs.words:
Headlights running through the rain
I keep on driving all the same
Turn it up and let it go
Nobody needs to know my name

songs.title: Paper Boats
songs.words:
We made paper boats in May
Watched them float and drift away
Now the river runs too fast
Still I wait for them to stay
